register.labelZh: BE DOWN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: BE DOWN Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: be down 可以表示網站、機器、網絡或服務無法運作。；be down to somebody 可以說明誰需要作出決定或完成工作。；be down to something 可以表示某物只剩下少量或少數。；be down with something 可以描述患病;be down on somebody 則可以描述對某人十分負面或苛刻。
register.summaryEn: Be down lets you explain that a website, machine, network or service is not working. Be down to somebody shows who must make a decision or complete a task. Be down to something helps you explain that only a small number or amount is left. Be down with something describes illness, while be down on somebody describes a strongly negative attitude towards a person.
contextsZh: 清楚說明科技和服務故障
contextsEn: Report technology and service problems clearly
